prompt: Choose the best option for the blank.
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的選項。

options.whyZh: 不掃描登記出庫，原紀錄就不會結案；沿用它可讓封條註記與原委託留在一起。

options.text: start a new record without carrying over today’s notes
options.zh: 另開一筆紀錄，不轉入今天的註記
options.whyZh: 這會把查核結果和需要查閱該結果的取件作業分開。

options.text: discard the seal-check note after shelving the jars
options.zh: 把兩罐放回架上後丟掉封條查核註記
options.whyZh: 文件明說明天的快遞需要查閱封條查核註記。

options.text: close the original record by scanning R out
options.zh: 把 R 罐掃描登記出庫，結束原紀錄
options.whyZh: 封條無法確認時兩罐都不能掃描登記出庫；R 罐也不能代替 S 罐。

explanationZh: 不掃描登記出庫，原紀錄就不會結案；沿用它可讓封條註記與原委託留在一起。
evidence: Attach a separate label to the shipping bag, not to the jar. Keep the original jar IDs; otherwise we will lose the link between the readings and the specific jar that was tested. If the courier can’t verify the bag seal, shelve S beside R without scanning either jar out. The inventory system would otherwise close the collection record automatically. Tomorrow’s courier needs to see today’s seal-check note next to the original request, so continue under the existing record when the courier returns.
